t: Automating AI Insights: Pipulate, SQLitedict, and Dynamic Prompts in Jupyter
s: This article details a '1-to-many' AI insight generation workflow in Jupyter using Pipulate, enhancing a previous 1-to-1 model by fetching multiple structured AI insights per URL. It introduces SQLitedict for efficient web response caching and custom dynamic prompts for richer, JSON-formatted AI outputs.
sub: Dynamic prompt engineering for structured AI output
Pipulate and JupyterLab integration for automated data enrichment
